label: PF Backlog 234
title: Parallel section/feature generation
body: Run sectioned/per-feature section calls in parallel (bounded worker pool) instead of serially; merge deterministically. Biggest wall-clock win; quality-neutral (order-independent).

brief.problem: Sectioned/per-feature generation runs agent calls serially, making generation wall-clock-bound.
brief.what_adds: Run section/per-feature agent calls in parallel with a bounded worker pool and merge results deterministically.
brief.why: Biggest wall-clock win; order-independent merge keeps quality neutral.
brief.who_feels: PF platform maintainers, workers, and customers.

objective: Run section/per-feature agent calls in parallel with a bounded worker pool and merge results deterministically.
acceptance_criteria: parallel section generation runs with bounded concurrency
approach: Run independent section calls in a bounded pool (respecting capacity), collect results, and merge deterministically (stable ordering); remain fail-closed on any error.
verification: parallel section generation runs with bounded concurrency
risks: one slow section stalls the merge

api_impact.reason: no API surface declared in backend_capability

analysis.implementation_strategy: EXTEND agent_runtime section-generation loop with a bounded ThreadPool/asyncio pool; collect results, sort by section key before merge; thread budget through run_breaker so per-run budgets still apply. Reuse run_manifest/evidence as-is with concurrency-safe writes.
dependency_findings: RELATED BI-0106 (same bounded-concurrency pattern, could share helper)
BI-0220 REQUIRES coordination: events/budgets must be emitted correctly under parallelism
BI-0224 (structured output) would make merge simpler — optional
conflict_findings: Direct file overlap with BI-0220 on agent_runtime.py — sequence or feature-flag
Overlap with BI-0106 if both add concurrency helpers — dedupe into one utility
duplication_findings: BI-0106 parallelizes stage-4 layer agents (adjacent, different call site)
BI-PF-1197 is groom CLI parallelism (different surface)
BI-0220 may add lifecycle events — must coexist
analysis.rationale: Biggest wall-clock win per body; small, low-risk EXTEND of existing runtime; Should priority behind reliability P0.
assumptions: Section calls are independent (no shared mutable state)
Order-independence already holds per BI-0224 note in body
Concurrency limit small (2-8) fits provider quotas
risks: Non-determinism if merge is not strictly keyed/sorted
Provider rate-limit pressure under parallel calls (needs pacing awareness)
evidence: Existing agent_runtime.py + run_manifest.py + run_breaker.py cover execution points
BI-0106 precedent for bounded concurrency pattern
missing_info: Default worker count and where it's configured (engineering-workers.json vs run config)
Whether provider rate pacing (BI-0220 P2) must land first

context_review.reason: Extension points clearly identified; remaining items are config choices.

dependencies.required_state: lifecycle events + budgets respected under parallel execution
structured output contracts stable for merge
